title: Godot 4.4.1 falls back to forward plus
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6

### System information

Windows 10 (build number if known) Intel HD Graphics 520 (integrated) Vulkan 1.0.66

### Issue description

When I set an invalid renderer type in the project settings, the engine prints an error, defaults to Forward+ in the log, and then crashes immediately. I expected it to either fall back gracefully to a valid renderer or show an error dialog without crashing.

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce:

Create a new project or open an existing one that works normally.

In project.godot, under [rendering] or [renderer] section, add a line such as:

renderer/rendering_method="someinvalidentry"

Save the file and start the project in the editor.

Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org/
vkEnumerateInstanceVersion not available, assuming Vulkan 1.0.
Vulkan 1.0.66 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Intel - Intel(R) HD Graphics 520
ERROR: Cannot instantiate RenderingDevice-based renderer with renderer type 'someinvalidentry'. Defaulting to Forward+ renderer.
at: RendererCompositorRD (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_compositor_rd.cpp:333)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

A new project but started with hardware that does not support Forward+
